claims: Mother's Day (Mothering Sunday) in the UK for 2026 is on Sunday, 15 March 2026.
Mother's Day (Mothering Sunday) in the UK is celebrated on the fourth Sunday of Lent.
Mother's Day in the UK is known as Mothering Sunday.
Mothering Sunday in the UK is rooted in a tradition linked to the fourth Sunday of Lent.
The consensus among national calendars is 15 March 2026 for Mother's Day 2026 in the UK
